propositions: rebar config validate only scans raw TOML for removed/tombstoned inputs and bypasses typed coercion, allowing invalid enum values to pass validation
reconciler.rich_text_cutover accepts an invalid value "clould" in rebar config validate (exit 0) but is correctly rejected by rebar config due to enum constraint {"off", "cloud", "dc", "both"}
config validate must aggregate both tombstone scan results and typed-value coercion errors from the canonical _SECTIONS path in a single run, reporting all failures before exit

the command contract was intentionally limited to tombstone-only validation per docs/config.md and tests/interfaces/contracts/test_tombstone_registry.py, but product authorization approved expanding it to include full typed-value validation
